Today, Apple TV released the trailer for the fifth season of 《Stillwater》, a Peabody and Emmy Award-winning mindfulness series on the platform. Here it is for everyone to watch together.

《Stillwater》 will return on August 21.

A few days ago, Apple TV confirmed the premiere date for the fifth season of 《Stillwater》, with all five episodes dropping on August 21.

According to Apple TV, the new season of 《Stillwater》 will feature more 「breathing exercises, mindfulness moments, and simple everyday practices」, continuing the show's mission of helping children and families find inner peace.

《Stillwater》 originally premiered on Apple TV in 2020, and has since won the Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Editing in a Preschool Animated Program, as well as the Peabody Award in the Children's/Youth category.
